This particular file is simple: it keeps an in-memory map of IP addresses to timestamps, and on every request to `/auth/forgot` it filters that IP's timestamps down to the last fifteen minutes — once there are six or more in that window, it returns a 429 and never calls `next()`, so the controller (and the email send) never runs for request number seven onward.

Nobody asked for this, and whether to keep it or rip it out is entirely your call — I'm not touching any code here. One thing worth knowing for when you do decide: that `Map` lives in memory, so it resets if the server restarts and won't be shared across multiple server instances if you ever scale horizontally.
